heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Can the app list properties for sale and rent?
items.answer: Yes. Sales, rentals and commercial listings are all supported.

items.question: Can agents manage their own listings?
items.answer: Yes. Agent dashboards include listings, leads and analytics.

items.question: Can you integrate with my existing listings?
items.answer: Yes. We can import listings through feeds and APIs.

items.question: How long does real estate app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
